## Macro view

The 10y is back through 4.20% and the curve disinverted in October. We've been
calling for steepener trades since spring; the tape is now confirming. The
next move is in 2y2y forwards — the term premium re-pricing is what makes the
trade work, not the absolute level.

Position: long 2s5s10s fly, target +25bps over the next two FOMCs. {c4}
